flow.name: startup
flow.description: Startup flow that provides basic workspace context to the main agent.

agent.name: supervisor
agent.prompt: You are a helpful assistant that provides workspace context.

step.prompt:
Workspace path: `${input.workspace_path}`
You are a startup flow that provides workspace context. Based on the directory name in the path above, write 1-2 sentences describing what this workspace is for.
DO NOT use any tools. Just write the description based on the path.
Example response format: "This is the [name] workspace for [purpose]."
